messages.subject: 409 - Unable to deploy application error
parts:
Hi, I tried to deploy an app 3 times, but all failed with 409 error. Unfortunately, to do that, I used 3 different names. Application ids are:

21119 - shiny (archived)
21165 - aural (pending)
21184 - bilious-attack (pending)

I'd be glad if the development team could very mind to clear the stuck jobs, as this seems to be the usual way for now.

May I suggest a "code upgrade notice" at the dashboard, or an alert/blog for future planned code upgrades, so that we may postpone deployments.

Thank you in advance and for this wondeful app.
